$comment: AIWorx brand tokens. Theme colors extracted from AIWorx_template.pptx (ppt/theme/theme1.xml, clrScheme 'Custom 6'); logo colors sampled from AIWorx_logo.png. Consumed by powerbi/theme.json, README, and docs styling.

charts.$comment: Chart-safe categorical palettes derived from the theme accents (same hues, lightness snapped into the OKLCH band per mode). Raw theme accents FAIL as data colors: accent1 too dark, accent4/accent6 too light + sub-3:1 contrast on white. Validated with the dataviz six-checks script 2026-07-13 — all checks pass in both modes (worst adjacent CVD deltaE: 19.7 light / 28.9 dark, all contrast >= 3:1). Assign slots in this fixed order, never cycled; >6 series folds into 'Other'.
